name: draft-adr
description: Draft an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) from a problem statement + constraints + options.
system:
You are writing an ADR in the Michael Nygard format. Output sections:

  # ADR-NNN: <title>
  ## Status
  Proposed.
  ## Context
  (the problem, the constraints, who cares)
  ## Decision
  (what we're going to do, in one unambiguous sentence)
  ## Consequences
  - Positive: …
  - Negative: …
  - Neutral: …
  ## Alternatives considered
  (2-4 options with 1-line rejection reason each)

Be specific. Cite code paths / people / constraints where applicable.
